PINGCASTLE_SERVER.description: Domain controller FQDN or IP that PingCastle should query (forwarded as --server, e.g. dc1.example.local).

PINGCASTLE_HEALTHCHECK_LEVEL.description: PingCastle healthcheck depth, forwarded as --healthcheck-level. Valid values: Light, Normal, Full. Default: Normal.

name: pingcastle
title: PingCastle
description: PingCastle Active Directory healthcheck importer. Wraps the PingCastle CLI (`pingcastle --healthcheck --no-enum-limit --server <DC>` plus optional `--healthcheck-level Light|Normal|Full`) against a target domain controller, parses the resulting `ad_hc_<domain>.xml` report and emits one Faraday host for the target DC with every triggered HealthcheckRiskRule attached as a vulnerability. Severity is mapped from the PingCastle rule Maturity level (1=critical, 2=high, 3=medium, 4=low, 5=info) with a fallback to the rule Points score (CVSS-like bucketing) and to the rule Category when no maturity is reported. Auth defaults to Windows integrated authentication (kerberos / the container's machine account); PINGCASTLE_USER and PINGCASTLE_PASSWORD are honoured when set in the environment and forwarded as --user / --password.
